selection.reason: Use the untouched held-out split for the release gate; development cases remain available for iteration.

semantic_judge.scope: Claim support against the cited passage and against the union of passages cited by each answer statement.

metrics.citation_validity: Every emitted source rank exists in the response source list.
metrics.citation_completeness: Every factual answer statement has at least one source rank.
metrics.exact_citation_support: The normalized extractive statement occurs in every passage it cites.
metrics.semantic_citation_support: HHEM support score for each statement/cited-passage pair.
metrics.semantic_answer_faithfulness: HHEM support score for each statement against the union of its cited passages.
metrics.no_answer_accuracy: Unanswerable cases return no sources and the explicit no-answer response.

supported.premise: Approved refunds return to the original payment method.
supported.hypothesis: Approved refunds return to the original payment method.

unsupported.premise: Approved refunds return to the original payment method.
unsupported.hypothesis: Approved refunds are always paid in cryptocurrency.

notes: The local HHEM judge requires no API key and no client document leaves the machine.
HHEM measures support, not whether the answer is useful or complete; retrieval and no-answer metrics remain separate.
The extractive generator makes exact span support testable, while HHEM provides a semantic check that can be reused with abstractive generators.
